Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.serializer.plain_text.jackson

Interface JacksonDeserializer<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the object to deserialize to
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface JacksonDeserializer<T>
A functional interface for deserializing a JsonNode into an object of type T. This is used to provide custom deserialization logic within the Jackson framework.

    • valueFromNode

      static Object valueFromNode(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode valueNode, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, TypeMapper typeMapper) throws IOException
      Converts a JsonNode to a standard Java object based on its node type. This utility method handles the conversion of primitive JSON types, arrays, and objects. For objects, it can perform polymorphic deserialization if a special _type property is present, using the provided TypeMapper.
      Parameters:
      valueNode - the JSON node to convert
      objectMapper - the Jackson ObjectMapper to use for data binding
      typeMapper - the TypeMapper used to resolve custom types for polymorphic deserialization
      Returns:
      the converted Java object (e.g., String, Number, Boolean, List, byte[], or a custom POJO)
      Throws:
      IOException - if the conversion fails due to an I/O error or a data binding issue
